name: Angelic Captain of Hestavar

items.name: Fullblade
items.description: This enormous, two-handed sword is favored by fighters and paladins.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Angelic Presence
traits.details: Attacks against the angel of battle take a -2 penalty unless the angel is bloodied.

traits.name: Ruination of the Marked
traits.details: Allies do 5 extra radiant damage when they hit a creature marked by an angelic captain of Hestavar.

powers.name: Many from One
powers.trigger: when an angel minion ally within 5 squares is reduced to zero or fewer hit points

effect.description: Four angel minions of the same type rise from the remains of the triggering angelic minion. These new minions appear in the square in which the triggering minion fell, or an unoccupied square adjacent to that square. These new minions act on the same initiative count as the angel minion that triggered the use of this power.
